name: plany
description: Lesson Planning Made Simple for Teachers

scripts.deploy:functions: cd functions && npm install && cd .. && firebase deploy --only functions --project plany-waugs --force
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npm test && firebase deploy --only hosting --project plany-waugs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm test && npm run deploy:rules && npm run deploy:functions && npm run deploy:hosting
scripts.test: node scripts/build-app.js --check && node --check public/js/app.js && node --test tests/logic.test.js
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm test && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d --project plany-waugs
